text: {"findings":[{"type":"PRIOR_ART","title":"Repeats EXP-035 without referencing it","detail":"EXP-035 already tested push notifications with live driver tracking to reduce where-is-my-order contacts, and it shipped. It found fatigue and opt-outs after the third push per order and recommended capping pushes at two. The proposal does not mention the experiment or the cap.","evidence_quote":"Send live tracking push notifications when the driver is five minutes away.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-035-live-tracking-nudges"],"recommendation":"Reference EXP-035. State what is new compared with it, and build in the two-push-per-order cap. Consider adding a notification opt-out guardrail."},{"type":"UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM","title":"35% contact reduction stated without a source","detail":"The 35% reduction is asserted as fact with no source. It also conflicts with the proposal's own target of 8.4 to 7.0 per 100, which is about a 17% reduction. The prior experiment, EXP-035, measured a 7% reduction.","evidence_quote":"This will cut where-is-my-order contacts by 35%.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-035-live-tracking-nudges"],"recommendation":"Remove the claim or cite its source. Align the expected effect with the stated target and with the EXP-035 result."}]}
